package lesson

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
)

// ListLessonsByCourse returns lessons for a course.
type ListLessonsByCourse struct {
	Courses  repository.CourseRepository
	Modules  repository.ModuleRepository
	Sections repository.SectionRepository
	Lessons  repository.LessonRepository
}

// Handle fetches lessons for the course.
func (uc ListLessonsByCourse) Handle(ctx context.Context, courseID string) ([]domain.Lesson, error) {
	_, err := uc.Courses.GetByID(ctx, courseID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return uc.Lessons.ListByCourse(ctx, courseID)
}

// HandleWithFields fetches lessons with specified fields only.
func (uc ListLessonsByCourse) HandleWithFields(ctx context.Context, courseID string, f queryfields.Set, filters filters.LessonFilters, sort *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error) {
	if courseID != "" {
		_, err := uc.Courses.GetByID(ctx, courseID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}

		// Apply courseID from URL if not set in filters
		if filters.CourseID == nil {
			filters.CourseID = &courseID
		}
	}

	if courseID == "" && filters.CourseID != nil && uc.Courses != nil {
		if _, err := uc.Courses.GetByID(ctx, *filters.CourseID); err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
	}

	if filters.SectionID != nil && uc.Sections != nil {
		if _, err := uc.Sections.Get(ctx, *filters.SectionID); err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
	}
	if filters.ModuleID != nil && uc.Modules != nil {
		if _, err := uc.Modules.Get(ctx, *filters.ModuleID); err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
	}

	return uc.Lessons.ListByCourseFields(ctx, courseID, f, filters, sort)
}
